title: Kestrel Ridge Energy Park
description: Hybrid plant monitor — 48 MWp solar · 36 MW wind · 20 MW / 80 MWh battery behind one grid connection (fictional)

targets.rawSql:
-- KPI · Generation today
-- Hourly solar + wind energy for the 48 h up to the end of the range.
-- The panel sums "today so far" and compares it with yesterday at the same time.
SELECT date_bin('1 hour', p.ts, timestamptz '2000-01-01') AS "time",
       round((sum(p.mw) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = 'pv_block')     * 0.25)::numeric, 2) AS solar_mwh,
       round((sum(p.mw) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = 'wind_turbine') * 0.25)::numeric, 2) AS wind_mwh
FROM plant.asset_power p
JOIN plant.asset a USING (asset_id)
WHERE a.kind IN ('pv_block', 'wind_turbine')
  AND p.ts >= date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz) - interval '1 day'
  AND p.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

-- KPI · Self-sufficiency
-- Share of the campus load covered on site (solar, wind, battery) per day:
-- 1 - imported / consumed. Last 30 days.
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)                                  AS "time",
       round((sum(load_mw) * 0.25)::numeric, 1)               AS load_mwh,
       round((sum(import_mw) * 0.25)::numeric, 1)             AS import_mwh,
       round((100 * (1 - sum(import_mw) / nullif(sum(load_mw), 0)))::numeric, 1) AS self_sufficiency_pct
FROM plant.site_meter
WHERE ts >  date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz) - interval '30 days'
  AND ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

-- KPI · Battery
-- Hourly state of charge and throughput, last 7 days. The panel shows the
-- latest SoC on a ring, the current mode, and equivalent full cycles.
SELECT date_bin('1 hour', s.ts, timestamptz '2000-01-01')            AS "time",
       round(avg(s.soc_pct)::numeric, 1)                              AS soc_pct,
       round(avg(p.mw)::numeric, 2)                                   AS bess_mw,
       round((sum(greatest(p.mw, 0)) * 0.25)::numeric, 2)             AS discharged_mwh
FROM plant.bess_state s
JOIN plant.asset_power p ON p.ts = s.ts AND p.asset_id = 'BESS'
WHERE s.ts > $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '7 days'
  AND s.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

-- KPI · CO2 avoided
-- Renewable energy x grid carbon intensity of the same hour, per day,
-- last 30 days (tonnes).
WITH gen AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('hour', p.ts) AS hr, sum(p.mw) * 0.25 AS mwh
    FROM plant.asset_power p
    JOIN plant.asset a USING (asset_id)
    WHERE a.kind IN ('pv_block', 'wind_turbine')
      AND p.ts >  date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz) - interval '30 days'
      AND p.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', g.hr)                              AS "time",
       round((sum(g.mwh * m.grid_gco2_kwh) / 1000)::numeric, 1) AS co2_avoided_t,
       round(sum(g.mwh)::numeric, 1)                         AS renewable_mwh
FROM gen g
JOIN plant.market m ON m.ts = g.hr
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

-- Generation mix vs campus load, with the day-ahead price.
-- Battery is signed: discharge stacks on top of generation, charging is
-- drawn below zero.
WITH b AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '3 days'
                THEN interval '15 minutes' ELSE interval '1 hour' END AS step
),
gen AS (
    SELECT date_bin(b.step, x.ts, timestamptz '2000-01-01') AS t,
           avg(x.solar) AS solar, avg(x.wind) AS wind, avg(x.bess) AS bess
    FROM (
        SELECT p.ts,
               sum(p.mw) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = 'pv_block')     AS solar,
               sum(p.mw) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = 'wind_turbine') AS wind,
               sum(p.mw) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = 'bess')         AS bess
        FROM plant.asset_power p
        JOIN plant.asset a USING (asset_id)
        WHERE $__timeFilter(p.ts)
        GROUP BY p.ts
    ) x, b
    GROUP BY 1
),
site AS (
    SELECT date_bin(b.step, ts, timestamptz '2000-01-01') AS t,
           avg(load_mw) AS load_mw, avg(import_mw) AS import_mw, avg(export_mw) AS export_mw
    FROM plant.site_meter, b
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT g.t                                     AS "time",
       round(g.solar::numeric, 2)              AS solar_mw,
       round(g.wind::numeric, 2)               AS wind_mw,
       round(g.bess::numeric, 2)               AS battery_mw,
       round(s.load_mw::numeric, 2)            AS load_mw,
       round(s.import_mw::numeric, 2)          AS import_mw,
       round(s.export_mw::numeric, 2)          AS export_mw,
       m.price_eur_mwh                         AS price_eur_mwh
FROM gen g
JOIN site s USING (t)
LEFT JOIN plant.market m ON m.ts = date_trunc('hour', g.t)
ORDER BY 1;

-- Energy flow (Sankey) over the selected range, in MWh.
-- Each 15-minute interval is allocated in merit order:
--   renewables -> campus first, surplus -> battery charging, rest -> export;
--   battery discharge -> campus, rest -> export; grid covers what is left.
WITH i AS (
    SELECT p.ts,
           sum(p.mw) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = 'pv_block')               AS solar,
           sum(p.mw) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = 'wind_turbine')           AS wind,
           greatest(sum(p.mw) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = 'bess'), 0)      AS dis,
           greatest(-sum(p.mw) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = 'bess'), 0)     AS chg
    FROM plant.asset_power p
    JOIN plant.asset a USING (asset_id)
    WHERE $__timeFilter(p.ts)
    GROUP BY p.ts
),
f AS (
    SELECT i.*, s.load_mw,
           least(i.solar + i.wind, s.load_mw)                                   AS ren_load
    FROM i JOIN plant.site_meter s USING (ts)
),
g AS (
    SELECT f.*,
           least(dis, load_mw - ren_load)                                       AS dis_load,
           least(solar + wind - ren_load, chg)                                  AS ren_chg
    FROM f
),
alloc AS (
    SELECT g.*,
           greatest(load_mw - ren_load - dis_load, 0)                           AS grid_load,
           greatest(chg - ren_chg, 0)                                           AS grid_chg,
           greatest(solar + wind - ren_load - ren_chg, 0)                       AS ren_exp,
           greatest(dis - dis_load, 0)                                          AS dis_exp,
           solar / nullif(solar + wind, 0)                                      AS sf
    FROM g
),
flows(source, target, mw) AS (
    SELECT 'Solar', 'Campus',      ren_load * coalesce(sf, 0)     FROM alloc UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Wind',  'Campus',      ren_load * (1 - coalesce(sf, 0)) FROM alloc UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Solar', 'Battery in',  ren_chg * coalesce(sf, 0)      FROM alloc UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Wind',  'Battery in',  ren_chg * (1 - coalesce(sf, 0)) FROM alloc UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Solar', 'Grid export', ren_exp * coalesce(sf, 0)      FROM alloc UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Wind',  'Grid export', ren_exp * (1 - coalesce(sf, 0)) FROM alloc UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Battery out', 'Campus',      dis_load                 FROM alloc UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Battery out', 'Grid export', dis_exp                  FROM alloc UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grid import', 'Campus',      grid_load                FROM alloc UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grid import', 'Battery in',  grid_chg                 FROM alloc
)
SELECT source, target, round((sum(mw) * 0.25)::numeric, 1) AS mwh
FROM flows
GROUP BY source, target
HAVING sum(mw) * 0.25 >= 0.05
ORDER BY 3 DESC;

-- Battery dispatch: hourly charge / discharge power, state of charge and
-- the day-ahead price the dispatch is chasing.
SELECT date_bin('1 hour', s.ts, timestamptz '2000-01-01') AS "time",
       round(avg(p.mw)::numeric, 2)                        AS battery_mw,
       round(avg(s.soc_pct)::numeric, 1)                   AS soc_pct,
       max(m.price_eur_mwh)                                AS price_eur_mwh
FROM plant.bess_state s
JOIN plant.asset_power p ON p.ts = s.ts AND p.asset_id = 'BESS'
LEFT JOIN plant.market m ON m.ts = date_trunc('hour', s.ts)
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

-- Wind power curve: hourly mean wind speed vs each turbine's output.
-- Hours inside a logged downtime are excluded, so what remains below the
-- reference curve is genuine under-performance.
SELECT a.asset_id,
       date_bin('1 hour', p.ts, timestamptz '2000-01-01') AS "time",
       round(avg(w.wind_ms)::numeric, 2)                   AS wind_ms,
       round(avg(p.mw)::numeric, 3)                        AS mw
FROM plant.asset_power p
JOIN plant.asset a USING (asset_id)
JOIN plant.weather w USING (ts)
WHERE a.kind = 'wind_turbine'
  AND $__timeFilter(p.ts)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM plant.downtime d
        WHERE d.asset_id = p.asset_id
          AND p.ts >= d.start_ts AND p.ts < coalesce(d.end_ts, 'infinity'))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

-- Solar yield heatmap: PV energy per day x hour, last 30 days
SELECT date_trunc('day', p.ts)::date         AS day,
       extract(hour FROM p.ts)::int          AS hour,
       round((sum(p.mw) * 0.25)::numeric, 2) AS pv_mwh
FROM plant.asset_power p
JOIN plant.asset a USING (asset_id)
WHERE a.kind = 'pv_block'
  AND p.ts >  date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz) - interval '29 days'
  AND p.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  AND extract(hour FROM p.ts) BETWEEN 6 AND 19
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

-- Fleet health: one row per generating asset with energy, availability
-- (producing while the resource is there) and a performance index against
-- the median of its peers.
WITH win AS (
    SELECT p.asset_id, a.kind, a.capacity_mw,
           sum(p.mw) * 0.25 AS mwh,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE (a.kind = 'pv_block' AND w.ghi_wm2 > 80)
                               OR (a.kind = 'wind_turbine' AND w.wind_ms BETWEEN 3.5 AND 25)) AS resource_n,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((a.kind = 'pv_block' AND w.ghi_wm2 > 80)
                               OR (a.kind = 'wind_turbine' AND w.wind_ms BETWEEN 3.5 AND 25)) AND p.mw > 0.01) AS producing_n
    FROM plant.asset_power p
    JOIN plant.asset a USING (asset_id)
    JOIN plant.weather w USING (ts)
    WHERE a.kind IN ('pv_block', 'wind_turbine')
      AND $__timeFilter(p.ts)
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
peer AS (
    SELECT kind, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY mwh) AS median_mwh
    FROM win GROUP BY kind
),
last_event AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (asset_id) asset_id, kind AS event_kind, reason, start_ts, end_ts
    FROM plant.downtime
    WHERE start_ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    ORDER BY asset_id, start_ts DESC
)
SELECT w.asset_id,
       w.kind,
       w.capacity_mw,
       round(w.mwh::numeric, 1)                                         AS energy_mwh,
       round((100.0 * w.producing_n / nullif(w.resource_n, 0))::numeric, 1) AS availability_pct,
       round((100 * w.mwh / nullif(pr.median_mwh, 0))::numeric, 1)      AS performance_pct,
       CASE WHEN e.end_ts IS NULL AND e.start_ts IS NOT NULL            THEN 'down'
            WHEN 100.0 * w.producing_n / nullif(w.resource_n, 0) < 95  THEN 'availability'
            WHEN 100 * w.mwh / nullif(pr.median_mwh, 0) < 95           THEN 'underperforming'
            ELSE 'ok' END                                               AS status,
       CASE WHEN e.start_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz THEN e.reason END          AS last_event
FROM win w
JOIN peer pr USING (kind)
LEFT JOIN last_event e USING (asset_id)
ORDER BY w.kind, w.asset_id;
